mappings.applicability_reason: The nightly export carries confidential PII (customer names, emails, message bodies) and the flow crosses the helpdesk/pipeline trust boundary (tb-001), which is exactly the pair of applicable_conditions this requirement names: sensitive data being transmitted, and a boundary the system does not fully control on both sides.

The threat's own attack path describes the exporter pulling transcripts from the helpdesk on a nightly schedule, not the helpdesk delivering events to an endpoint the system exposes. This matches req-WEBHOOK-001's non_applicable_conditions entry for events polled by the system rather than delivered to it, so inbound-event authenticity verification is out of scope for this flow.

This requirement addresses documentation of retention and usage terms where customer data is sent outward to an external provider that processes it. The described flow (evd-002) is the reverse: the pipeline's exporter pulls data from the Helpdesk into its own training store, so no customer data is being sent to an external processor in this direction.

The nightly export is a batch job moving data between the Helpdesk and the Transcript Exporter, with no end user in the path. req-AUTH-001's non_applicable_conditions covers components not reachable by end users, which describes this service-to-service flow (evd-002).

documentation_gaps.title: Encryption and authentication of the nightly transcript export are undocumented
documentation_gaps.description: The system overview names the nightly export job and states the sensitivity of what it carries -- full transcripts including customer names, email addresses, and message bodies (evd-002, evd-003) -- but does not state whether the connection between the Helpdesk and the Transcript Exporter is encrypted in transit, or how either side authenticates the other.
documentation_gaps.importance: Because full, unredacted PII traverses this path every night, whether the channel is encrypted and authenticated is what separates a benign internal data pull from a viable interception path (req-DATA-001). Without this, the assessment cannot distinguish an inherited transport protection from an absent one.
requested_evidence: Network or transport configuration for the nightly export job, e.g. TLS version and certificate validation in use
The authentication mechanism used between the Transcript Exporter and the Helpdesk, such as an API credential, mutual TLS, or a service identity
